## Description {#details}

<p>A recipe for handling phis that are widened in the vector loop.</p>


<p>In the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vplan">VPlan</a> native path, all incoming VPValues &amp; <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vpbasicblock">VPBasicBlock</a> pairs are managed in the recipe directly.</p>


<p>Definition at line 2306 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/vplan-h">VPlan.h</a>.</p>
